metadata.winter_weather_note: Feb 15–Mar 23 NYC average highs range ~42–53°F (lows ~29–38°F). Activities are balanced with 10 indoor world-class museums/observatories/theaters and 6 crisp-day outdoor/harbor landmarks, all reachable within <=60 minutes by MTA subway/bus from Manhattan & LIC/Brooklyn transit-hub hotels (with The Met Cloisters & Liberty Island security buffer explicitly annotated).
